title: Pangasinan tops 2025 Ilocos Region economic performance

blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan – Pangasinan province’s economy grew by 4.3 percent in 2025 and maintained its lead in the Ilocos region, posting P408.45 billion in economic output as poverty incidence dropped to 8.6 percent. This was based on the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) and the Department of Economy, Planning and Development (DEPDev) during the 2025 Provincial Product Accounts Dissemination Forum in Binmaley town on Tuesday (Sept. 29). Pangasinan’s output rose by P16.83 billion from 2024’s P391.62 billion. It accounted for 53.1 percent of the Ilocos Region’s economy and contributed 2.30 percentage points to the region’s 4.5 percent growth. READ: Pangasinan slashes road, […]...
